raj_patel: Heads-up — our staging deploys started failing ~06:02 UTC with 403 from Redwood API when the CI runner calls the model-start endpoint. Started right after I pushed a tighter SA policy. Any quick eyeballs?

amanda_w: Can you paste the error/headers? Were you changing token TTL or role bindings?

raj_patel: Error from runner logs: 
```
POST /v1/models/redwood-server/start 403
{"error":"permission denied","details":"serviceAccount:ci-runner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com missing iam.serviceAccounts.actAs"}
```
I changed the SA policy to remove broad projects/* binding and added an IAM Condition limiting actAs to sessions <=3600s. Noticed CI runs take ~50–70m.

sarah_ops: That IAM condition could be the culprit — if the runner exchanges OIDC for short-lived creds that are minted >3600s sessionDuration or the impersonation call isn't passing lifetime param, GCP will reject. Also double-check impersonation permissions across projects.

amanda_w: Could be the impersonation window mismatch we've seen before. Raj, what's the CI token flow? GitLab runner uses workload identity to fetch an OIDC token and then calls IAM Credentials API to generateAccessToken for the SA. If generateAccessToken request omitted "lifetime" or requested >3600s, the condition denies.

raj_patel: Flow: gitlab -> oidc -> OIDC token audience=iam.googleapis.com -> GCP STS -> generateAccessToken (default lifetime). I didn't explicitly set lifetime in the code path — thought default would be fine.

eng-mike: Quick repro I ran: if you set IAM Condition to sessionDuration <= "3600s" and the generateAccessToken request asks for 1h (3600s) vs default (1h) it can be borderline depending on clock skew. Also if runner caches tokens, renewal could produce a token with expiry pushing past the condition. I saw a 403 with identical message.

sarah_ops: Short-term workaround: roll back the IAM Condition change or widen it to sessionDuration <= "7200s" so existing runner behavior works. Long-term: modify CI to explicitly pass lifetime=3600s in generateAccessToken and add a pre-step test to fail fast when impersonation denied.

raj_patel: Rolling back now — will patch infra and re-run. Also adding a job to check iam.serviceAccounts.actAs present before deploy.

ci-bot: DEPLOYMENT STATUS: rollback started for commit f3a2b7e — all staging runners paused. :warning:

amanda_w: Once rollback is confirmed, let's coordinate a safe policy that enforces least-priv without causing deploys to fail. Recommend: enforce actAs + require explicit lifetime <=3600s and update CI to pass lifetime param and renew tokens on run start (no caching).

raj_patel: Rollback completed, staging deploys back to green at 06:11 UTC. Thanks everyone. I'll file a follow-up RFC for CI token changes and add a postmortem action: add an automated gate in the CD pipeline to validate SA bindings.

eng-mike: One more note: add audit-log alert for repeated iam.serviceAccounts.actAs denials so support can detect this pattern earlier.

sarah_ops: Great. Closing but tagging for follow-up: @amanda_w @eng-mike. :thumbsup:
